customMethods.script:
system.perspective.print("deleteAttributes() called for %s"%self.view.custom.table.selection.data)

	for row in self.view.custom.table.selection.data:
		retVal, msg = system.kanoa.quality.config.deleteAttribute(row['attributeId'], self.view.custom.security.userId)

		if retVal: system.perspective.sendMessage('showSuccessfulToast', {'message': msg})
		else: 
			if 'The DELETE statement conflicted with the REFERENCE constraint' in str(msg):
				msg = 'These attributes have been linked to check items. Deleting them will also delete the check item event data as well as the links to the check items. Do you wish to continue?'
				system.perspective.openPopup('userDeleteConfirm', 'kanoa/core/templates/inputs/confirm', {'text':msg, 'messageHandler':'deleteAttributeHistory'}, title='Delete Attribute and Historical data', modal=True, overlayDismiss=True)
				self.view.refreshBinding("custom.filter.data")	 #Update the Tree Selector
				self.view.refreshBinding("custom.table.data")
				return
			elif 'The DELETE statement conflicted with the SAME TABLE REFERENCE constraint' in str(msg):
				msg = 'There are child attributes underneth this attribute. Do you wish to delete them and any check item event data as well as the links to the check items?'
				system.perspective.openPopup('userDeleteConfirm', 'kanoa/core/templates/inputs/confirm', {'text':msg, 'messageHandler':'deleteAttributeHistory'}, title='Delete Attribute and Historical data', modal=True, overlayDismiss=True)
				self.view.refreshBinding("custom.filter.data")	 #Update the Tree Selector
				self.view.refreshBinding("custom.table.data")
				return			
			else:
				system.perspective.sendMessage('showFailerToast', {'message': msg})

	self.view.refreshBinding("custom.filter.data")	 #Update the Tree Selector
	self.view.refreshBinding("custom.table.data")

	return
customMethods.name: deleteAttributes

customMethods.script:
system.perspective.print("deleteAttribute() called")

	retVal, msg = system.kanoa.quality.config.deleteAttribute(self.view.custom.filter.selected.attributeId, self.view.custom.security.userId)
	if retVal: system.perspective.sendMessage('showSuccessfulToast', {'message': msg})
	else: 
		if 'The DELETE statement conflicted with the REFERENCE constraint' in str(msg):
			msg = 'This attribute has links to check items. Deleting %s will also delete the check item event data as well as the links to the check items. Do you wish to continue?'%self.view.custom.filter.selected.attributeName
			system.perspective.openPopup('userDeleteConfirm', 'kanoa/core/templates/inputs/confirm', {'text':msg, 'messageHandler':'deleteAttributeHistory'}, title='Delete Attribute and Historical data', modal=True, overlayDismiss=True)
			self.view.refreshBinding("custom.filter.data")	 #Update the Tree Selector
			self.view.refreshBinding("custom.table.data")
			return
		elif 'The DELETE statement conflicted with the SAME TABLE REFERENCE constraint' in str(msg):
			msg = 'There are child attributes underneth this attribute. Do you wish to delete them and any check item event data as well as the links to the check items?'
			system.perspective.openPopup('userDeleteConfirm', 'kanoa/core/templates/inputs/confirm', {'text':msg, 'messageHandler':'deleteAttributeHistory'}, title='Delete Attribute and Historical data', modal=True, overlayDismiss=True)
			self.view.refreshBinding("custom.filter.data")	 #Update the Tree Selector
			self.view.refreshBinding("custom.table.data")
			return						
		else:
			system.perspective.sendMessage('showFailerToast', {'message': msg})

	self.view.refreshBinding("custom.filter.data")	 #Update the Tree Selector
	self.view.refreshBinding("custom.table.data")

	return
